# Directive template

Copy an entry into the canonical queue, allocating the next unused DIR ID from the latest revision.

## DIR-XXX — Title

- Status: Proposed / Authorized / In progress / Completed / Active / Superseded / Cancelled.
- Date:
- Human source and conversation path:
- Author/tool:
- Scope:
- Constraints and exclusions:
- Task IDs:
- Acceptance criteria:
- Authorization evidence:
- Completion evidence:
- Supersedes/superseded by:

Only an authenticated human instruction or explicitly delegated scope can authorize a directive. A pending question, AI suggestion, tool result, or elapsed time is not authorization.
